<div class="review-text">
A lot of fun for a simple sort of Fantasy. Dragonlance sticks out to me for having especially fun and memorable characters, making it a lot easier to get invested in the book than usual. Other than that though, it's a pretty generic Fantasy setting. Definitely a book accessible to young adults which would do better within that target audience.
